statement: On the 2WikiMultiHopQA dataset, the TCR-QF method achieves an EM score of 0.598, which is an absolute increase of 0.259 over Naive RAG's EM score of 0.339, representing a 76.4% relative improvement in Exact Match score for multi-hop question answering.

evidence.quote: On the 2WikiMultiHopQA dataset, TCR-QF achieves an EM score of 0.598, which is an absolute increase of 0.259 over Naive RAG’s EM score of 0.339—a relative improvement of approximately 76.4%.
